source_signal.chronology: At source block B, state includes source fills through B. Target baseline must be from a block < B; target response must be from a block > B.
source_signal.house_scalar: QP/KL coherent category projection followed by frozen 218-seat MaxEnt point: P(R>=220)+0.4*P(215-219).
source_signal.senate_scalar: QP/KL coherent category projection followed by T50=P(R seats>=50). T51 is excluded from candidate selection because settlement semantics remain unresolved.
source_signal.delta: current eligible source scalar minus immediately previous eligible source scalar
source_signal.shock_threshold: 75th percentile of absolute non-zero delta estimated on TRAIN source events only, separately by family and geometry
source_signal.deduplication: If multiple shocks map to the same future target block, keep the earliest source shock only.

outcomes.primary: first direct target update strictly after source block, provided observed within 300 seconds
outcomes.no_update_rule: Do not impute zero target move when no target fill is observed in the window; report coverage instead.
outcomes.target_change: future target price minus last target price strictly before source block

estimator.baseline: target_before persistence / zero predicted target move

metrics: 1000 UTC-day cluster bootstrap of MAE improvement

requirements: QP and KL both have positive DEV absolute MAE improvement
QP and KL first- and second-half DEV MAE improvement >= 0
primary_gate.rule: 5s/30s diagnostics may demote but never rescue a failed 300s primary.
